texts.title: War Beyond the Reach
texts.body: The Senate has voted war on a nation beyond the rim. The motion carried; the fleets may sail; the chamber is loud with houses deciding, after the fact, how they feel about it. {self.name} is asked, in the colonnade, where {self.house} stands.

texts.title: The Fleet Sails
texts.body: The fleet of {self.house} clears the last beacon and turns beyond the Reach. It will be years before it fights and more before word comes back. The crews are on deck; the harbour is on the gallery; the admiral is waiting to be seen off.

choices.pay_the_crews_forward: Pay the crews a season forward (4 credits).
choices.watch_them_go: Watch them go, and say nothing.

texts.title: Word of a Victory
texts.body: A dispatch, two years old by the time it reaches the Reach: the fleet of {self.house} met the enemy in their own space and beat them. Hulls lost, plunder taken, the tally turned a point. The chamber has not heard yet.

choices.let_it_be_known: Have it read in the chamber.
choices.share_the_plunder: Send a share of it to the squares (4 credits).
choices.keep_it_close: File it. Victories are followed by defeats.

texts.title: Word of a Defeat
texts.body: A dispatch, late and short: the fleet of {self.house} was beaten in the enemy's space. Hulls lost; the tally turned against the Reach; the admiral alive, or not — the dispatch is unclear. The chamber will ask.

texts.title: The Broken Expedition
texts.body: What is left of the fleet of {self.house} has been sighted at the beacons: a hull, maybe two, limping for home from beyond the Reach. The families are at the harbour already. The Senate that sent it is not.

choices.mourn_them: Go down to the harbour and stand with the families.
choices.blame_the_senate: Tell the chamber it sent them too few, too far.
choices.rebuild_quietly: Lay down new hulls, and say nothing (6 credits).

texts.title: The Fleet Comes Home
texts.body: The fleet of {self.house} is home from beyond the Reach, with its plunder and its dead and its stories. The harbour town has turned out; the crews want paying; the admiral wants to be seen.

choices.pay_off_the_crews: Pay the crews in full on the quay (6 credits).
choices.back_to_stations: Back on station within the week.

texts.title: The Triumph
texts.body: The nation has sued for peace and will pay the Reach tribute for twenty years, and the Senate has named {self.house} the house whose fleets won it. The Reach gives a triumph once in a generation: the laurel, the procession, the chamber on its feet. It is waiting on {self.name}.

choices.the_laurel: Take the laurel and the procession.
choices.the_modest_general: Decline the procession; give the laurel to the fleet.
choices.a_share_of_the_tribute: Ask the chamber for a share of the tribute.

texts.title: Raiders From Beyond
texts.body: They came out of the dark beyond the rim, took cargo and crews from a world of {self.house}, and were gone before any fleet could answer. The town is in uproar; the frontier wants to know what the Reach will do; the chamber has not yet heard.

choices.call_for_war: Stand in the chamber and call for war.
choices.arm_the_world: Arm the world and pay a garrison (4 materials, 3 credits).
choices.bear_it: Count the cost and bear it.

texts.title: The War Abroad Is Lost
texts.body: The tally turned against the Reach and stayed there, and the chair has bought peace from a nation beyond the rim at thrice the tribute it hoped to take. The fleets are coming home. The chamber wants someone to blame.

choices.blame_the_consuls: Lay it at the consuls' door.
choices.call_for_the_fleet: Call for a real fleet of the Reach, paid by the chamber.

texts.title: The Tribute Comes In
texts.body: A nation beyond the Reach has sued for peace and its first tribute has reached the chair's coffers, and not yours. The chamber is already arguing about whose war it was and whose credits these are.

choices.move_to_share_it: Move that the tribute be shared.
choices.move_to_build_with_it: Move that it lay down hulls and lanes.

texts.title: Met at the March
texts.body: Raiders came through the march this year and found your fleet standing there. They did not try it. No world of the rim was touched, and most of the houses whose worlds they would have been do not yet know why.

choices.keep_the_station: Keep the station, and pay the crews early.
choices.make_it_known: Let the Senate hear whose fleet it was.
choices.say_nothing: Say nothing. It is what the fleet is for.

texts.title: A New Hand Beyond the Rim
texts.body: One of the nations beyond the Reach has a new ruler. What kind is in the dispatches: the warlike sour toward the Reach; the wary raid only when the quarrel is real; the grasping raid for twice the cargo; the mild are easier to deal with. Sometimes it is the commander of their fleets who takes the chair, and those are never mild.

choices.send_an_envoy: Send an envoy with a gift.
choices.watch_the_march: Double the watch at the march.
choices.let_it_pass: Read the dispatch and turn to the next.

texts.title: Their Commander Falls
texts.body: Your fleet has beaten theirs in their own space, and the commander of their fleets was killed in the rout. Whoever follows will be new to it. For a while the border will be quieter than it has been.

choices.honour_the_dead: Send the body home under a flag of truce.
choices.take_the_name: Let the Reach know whose fleet did it.

texts.title: The Host Is Through the March
texts.body: Their host has come through the march and is bound for a world of the Reach. It will sit over that world until the world falls, which takes it longer than it would take a fleet of the Reach, and then it will go home with what it took. The houses that mean to stop it have that long.

choices.send_word: Write to the houses near the march with what is known.
choices.see_to_our_own: Look to our own orbits first.

texts.title: A World of the Reach Is Taken
texts.body: Their host has taken a world of the Reach. It is theirs until a house of the Reach frees it, or until the peace: if the Reach wins the war the world goes home, and if not it is ceded. Its house is asking who will help.

choices.speak_for_its_house: Say in the Senate that it was taken from all of us.
choices.say_nothing: Say nothing. It was not our world.

texts.title: Our World Is Taken
texts.body: Their host has taken a world of your own house. It is theirs until a fleet of the Reach frees it, yours or another's, or until the peace. If the war is lost it will be ceded.

choices.appeal_to_the_senate: Ask the Senate to remember whose war this is.
choices.swear_to_take_it_back: Swear the house will take it back itself.

texts.title: A World Freed for Us
texts.body: Another house's fleet has driven them off the world they took from you, and it is yours again. That house asked for nothing. It will remember what you say now.

choices.thank_them_handsomely: Send a gift and thank them where it will be heard.
choices.take_it_as_owed: Take it as one house's due from another.

texts.title: We Freed a World
texts.body: Your fleet has freed a world they had taken from another house. It has gone home to that house, as a freed world does. What you ask for it is yours to decide.

choices.ask_the_cost_of_the_fleet: Send them the bill for the fuel and the hulls.

texts.title: Their Host Is Beaten
texts.body: Your fleet has met their host and beaten it. That counts for more in the tally of the war than anything short of taking a world, and it will be talked about.

choices.give_the_crews_their_due: Pay the crews a bounty from the house's purse.
choices.let_the_reach_know: See that the Reach knows whose colours led.

texts.title: Ceded at the Peace
texts.body: The war is over and it was not won. A world of the Reach that they held when the peace was made stays theirs. It can be taken back, but only in another war.

choices.call_it_a_shame: Call it a shame in the Senate, and name no one.
choices.say_it_will_be_taken_back: Say it will be taken back in the next.

texts.title: The Camps Are Restless
texts.body: The world your house holds beyond the march is restless. No fleet of yours has stood over it this year. Three years without three hulls in its orbit and it will rise and be theirs again, unless they are paying the Reach tribute.

choices.let_it_go_if_it_goes: Let it go, if it goes.

texts.title: The Camps Rise
texts.body: The world your house held beyond the march has risen. No fleet stood over it for three years, and it is theirs again without a battle.

choices.shrug_it_off: It was never going to be easy to keep.

texts.title: Their Capital Falls
texts.body: A fleet of the Reach has taken the world where their ruler sat. If there is a war, that ends it. Their ruler sits somewhere else now, and the world itself will need a fleet over it to be kept.

choices.ask_what_comes_after: Ask the Senate who will hold it, and with what.

texts.title: The Cities Are Hiring
texts.body: The Free Cities do not keep a great fleet. Attacked, they buy one: a hull comes into their harbours every year for as long as the war lasts and they hold Thessar. A war with them that is not won quickly is fought against more ships each year.

choices.say_strike_now: Say the time to go is now.

texts.title: The Cities Offer a Ransom
texts.body: The war is over and the Cities are paying tribute. They want their city back, the one your house holds, and they have named a price. The offer stands for two years. Take it and the city goes home; refuse and it is yours for as long as you keep a fleet over it, and the Cities will remember.

texts.title: A City Is Bought Back
texts.body: A city of the Shore that a house of the Reach took in the war has been bought back by the Cities. The house has its money and the city has its harbour. This is how the Cities end a war they have lost.

choices.call_it_their_way_of_war: It is their way of war.
choices.say_it_should_have_been_kept: Say it should have been kept.

texts.title: The Cities Stop Paying
texts.body: The Free Cities have stopped their tribute. They pay while a fleet of the Reach stands at their march or over their worlds, and for three years none has. Nothing in the treaty has changed; the ships went home.

choices.move_for_a_fleet_at_the_march: Say what the tribute costs: a squadron at the march.
choices.shrug: It was always going to happen.

texts.title: The Plunder of a City
texts.body: Your fleet has taken a city of the Shore. Its counting-houses were full, as they always are, and what was in them is aboard your ships. The crews are waiting to hear whose it is.

choices.share_it_with_the_crews: Pay a share to every crew.
choices.keep_it_for_the_house: Enter it all in the house's books.

texts.title: The City Is Restless
texts.body: The city your house holds on the Thessaran Shore is restless. No fleet of yours has stood over it this year. Six years without three hulls in its orbit and its council will shut the gates, unless the Cities are paying the Reach tribute.

texts.title: The City Shuts Its Gates
texts.body: The city your house held on the Shore has gone back to the Cities. No fleet stood over it for six years. Its council voted, and that was all it took.

choices.shrug_it_off: A fair account of a merchant's loyalty.

texts.title: The Cities Buy Their Peace
texts.body: The Senate voted a war on the Free Cities and it was not fought: no fleet met another, and for years nobody pressed them. The Cities have paid the house that holds the capital to end it. What each side took goes home, their cities for a ransom, and they owe no tribute.

choices.call_it_a_war_unfought: Say what a war voted and sold is worth.

texts.title: The Concord Crosses the Gate
texts.body: The Ardent Concord has made war on the Reach. Nobody voted it: the Council of Admirals saw the Reach divided and gave the order. Every house is at war with it. Two divisions will come through the Valmont Anvils and Ironhold, and they will not go home with one world.

choices.call_the_houses_to_the_east: Say the houses' quarrels can wait.
choices.look_to_our_own_quarrel: We have a quarrel nearer home.

texts.title: The Concord Comes Back for Its Own
texts.body: A house of the Reach holds a world that was the Concord's, and the Concord has made war to take it back. Its worlds do not rise of themselves as the Khanates' camps do. The Concord comes for them, with everything it has.

texts.title: Two Fleets Through the Marches
texts.body: The Concord's divisions are through the Ardent Gate and into the Reach. They fight a campaign: each takes a world, slowly, and then the next, for as long as it is supplied and unbeaten. A division is driven home by beating it.

choices.send_what_is_known: Send the eastern houses what is known.
choices.keep_our_fleet_where_it_is: Keep our fleet where it is.
